summary: Keep golang.org/x/net at a govulncheck-clean release, and keep the go directive at the repo .go-version floor without a toolchain line that selects a newer Go.
reason: Reachable html.Parse pulls golang.org/x/net, and v0.60.0 is GO-2026-6860 (fixed in v0.62.0). A later toolchain go1.27.2 pin is still affected by GO-2026-6809 and makes CI download that toolchain. A toolchain line equal to the go directive is redundant: go mod tidy deletes it and go build refuses to run until it is gone.
